description: Solo team working on Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars, in the Universal Event.
summary: Ingenuity flew 72 times on Mars after being built for five. This is the story of the helicopter NASA left behind.
